name: Assignment Submission Confirmation (Student)
description: Confirmation email sent to students after submitting an assignment
subject: Assignment Submission Confirmed: $assignment_title
body_text:
Dear $first_name,

This email confirms that your assignment has been successfully submitted.

Assignment Details:
- Module: $module_code - $module_name
- Assignment: $assignment_title
- Submission Version: $version_number
- Status: $submission_status$late_text
- Submission Time: $submission_time

Your submission is being processed and will be reviewed by your instructor. A separate email with the automatic plagiarism scan result will follow shortly.

You can view your submission details in the Assignment System.

$signature
